output.summary: KEP-4346 proposes adding client-go informer metrics (reflector, queue, and eventHandler internals) exposed to Prometheus, gated behind a new InformerMetrics feature gate. The KEP is marked implementable at alpha stage.
output.rationale: Operators cannot tell why an informer stalls without adding debug logs, so the KEP exposes reflector/queue/eventHandler metrics. Reviewers asked for a feature gate because earlier reflector metrics caused a memory leak and were reverted. The status is implementable, with the stage set to alpha.

alternatives.option: Keep the reflector metrics removed (no re-add)
alternatives.why_not: The readme says the change is needed because the removed reflector metrics were a memory leak, but it proposes reverting that removal behind a gate instead of leaving the metrics out.

alternatives.option: Enable the metrics by default without a feature gate
alternatives.why_not: Reviewers said earlier attempts were reverted after causing problems in the field, and the proposal adds the InformerMetrics feature gate; logicalhan later asked that the metrics be disabled by default and enabled only by explicit flag.

alternatives.option: Use an environment variable to enable them
alternatives.why_not: Reviewer rcomment:1481837519 notes an environment variable was updated to a feature gate instead.

evidence.quote: Add a feature gate `InformerMetrics` to enable informer/reflector metrics
I would ordinarily say no, but these in particular have been attempted at least once (I think twice) and reverted after causing issues in the field.
This change remove reflector metrics before https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/74636. It is essential to fix memory leak issue.
I think these metrics should only be enabled through an explicit flag, and disabled by default. We have been burned by this so many times
